system.story: She keys the rig and the case cracks open - a machine rolls out already answering to her.

effect.after:
Main action to deploy, maneuver to command; no Uptime cost. Deploy a drone (Drone Integrity 12 at Tier 5; it fields under your command), or Command your already-fielded fleet to move and act (they act on your turn - the extension model). On Outcome Tier 1 you deploy and issue a free command in the same action; on Tier 3 the drone fields unstable (acts next turn) or a command garbles. Swarm-Master: a single Deploy & Command orders the whole fleet.

Enhance - Spend 1 Uptime: deploy a second machine in the same action, or command the whole swarm at once (the Wide Band default).
